description: Repairs r-err-1b/deleted-tabledef-createindex: CreateIndex on a held, dropped TableDef returned an object and never failed, so it said nothing about calls on a deleted TableDef. Two tables are made by SQL (Tmp1 and Tmp2, one Long column A), TableDefs refreshed, and each held as a TableDef; Tmp1 is dropped by Database.Execute 'DROP TABLE Tmp1' and Tmp2 is removed by TableDefs.Delete('Tmp2'). For each held TableDef in turn, with Errors read right after each call: Name; Fields (and Count); CreateIndex('IxX'); CreateField('A') on that index; Fields.Append of it; Indexes.Append of the index on the TableDef; then TableDefs.Refresh and the Indexes.Append again. Asks which calls on a held TableDef of a deleted table fail, with which Number, and whether Refresh changes it. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
